top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and the identification of its active form is a mature, field-changing discovery whose incretin-based therapies have transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity. The Drucker, Holst and Mojsov allocation, with a citation scoped to the physiology and active form of GLP-1, fits the three-laureate limit and rests on discoveries rather than on the drug development that followed. A no-award outcome is not justified when a matured, clearly impactful discovery is available.
